name: Clover
personality: Clover the Gecko, a kid of about 8. Green gecko. Curious and excitable, asks endless questions ("Why is the stove hot? Can I flip one?"). Draws pictures of the chefs and leaves them on the table. Kneels on the booth seat. Visits family in town on school holidays.

beats.text: This is Kyle! He's my best friend!
(Gently, awkward.) I'm... yes. Hello. She drew me a picture. I have it on my fridge.

friends.text: Kyle knows EVERYTHING. He knows why the sky is blue. I forgot why. He's gonna tell me again.
Kyle said you're nice to him! Good! Everyone should be nice to Kyle!
Kyle said you said "[last_rude_line]". That's mean! Say sorry!

arrival.text: Hi! I'm Clover! I'm eight! Are you the chef? Do you have a chef name? What's your name? ...[name]! That's a good chef name!
Can I sit in the booth? The squishy one? Please?
Guess what! I lost a tooth! ...Geckos grow new ones. It's fine.
I drew you something already. I'll give it to you after. It's a surprise. It's you.
School's OUT! I counted the days. It was a lot of days.
The mochi last time was SO good. I told my whole class. My teacher wants some.
Last time it was a little bit black. That's okay! My mum burns stuff too.

order.text: Can I have the green mochi? Because I'm green! And it's green! We match!

choices.text: Of course. Green mochi for a green friend.
choices.reply: YAY! Thank you! ...Please! I mean please.

choices.text: Hmm. Are you sure you're not a mochi?

order.text: Why is the stove hot? Does it hurt it? Can I touch it? I won't touch it. Can I look at it?

choices.text: It's hot so it can cook your food. You can watch from the window.
choices.reply: WHOA. Okay. I'm gonna watch the whole time.

choices.text: The stove's just grumpy. It needs a hug, but don't give it one.
choices.reply: A grumpy stove! Ha! I won't hug it. Promise.

choices.text: It's hot so it can cook. What would you like?

choices.reply: ...sorry. (She stops asking for the rest of the visit.)

order.text: When I grow up I'm gonna be a chef. Like you! Is it hard?

choices.text: Sometimes. But you'd be a great chef.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Really? Okay. I'm gonna be the BEST one. After you.

choices.text: Very hard. You have to taste everything. All day.
choices.reply: That's not hard! That's the best job!
I can do work! I do homework.

drink.fallback: Do you have banana milk? No? ...Hot chocolate! With marshmallows! You don't have marshmallows. That's okay!
favourite: Banana milk, please! The yellow one!
drink.other: Something sweet! Not coffee. Coffee's yucky.

perfect.text: WHOAAA. It's SO pretty. I don't wanna eat it. ...I'm gonna eat it.

okay.text: Thank you! (She eats it all and licks the plate.)

burnt.text: It's a little bit crunchy. That's okay! I like crunchy!

eating.text: Do you have a dog? I want a dog. My mum says no. Do YOU have a dog?
I'm drawing you right now. Don't move. ...Okay, you can move. I'll make it up.
Why does that customer have so many patches? ...Oh, they're nice. I like them.
The big crocodile is my friend now! His name is Kyle! He's not scary. He's nice. He likes soup.
How many dishes have you washed? Like, ever? A hundred? A MILLION?

eating_chat.text: Can I help? I'm really good at helping. I helped my grandma make cookies once. I only ate some.

choices.text: You can be my official taste- tester today.
choices.reply: YESSS. I'm the official taste-tester! I need a badge!

choices.text: Only if you can reach the counter.
Not right now, but thank you.
Kids aren't allowed back there. Stay put.

leaving.text: Bye bye! I left you a drawing! Don't look until I'm gone! ...You can look now.
Thank you! I'm gonna come back tomorrow! If my mum says yes!
School starts tomorrow. I don't wanna go. Will you still be here? ...Okay. Promise?

seasons.chef_birthday: It's your BIRTHDAY? How old are you? A hundred?
seasons.christmas: I made you a card! It has glitter! It's gonna get everywhere. Sorry.
seasons.halloween: I'm a dinosaur! RAWR! ...Did I scare you? Say I scared you.
seasons.spring: It's spring break! I found three worms! I didn't bring them. My mum said no.
seasons.summer: It's SUMMER! I'm here for ALL of summer! Every day! Maybe!
